fix_subject: Fix map_contains to respect collations by rewriting collated key lookups through map_keys and list_contains
pr_title: Preserve the release branch's named map/key signature when registering the binding callback.

labels.summary: map_contains ignored collations on VARCHAR keys (including nested LIST/ARRAY key types), so collated key lookups returned wrong results; the fix binds such calls as list_contains(map_keys(map), key) so the collation is applied.
